name: Extract connectivity matrices from network datatype
summary: Converts a network datatype (JSON graph without node measurements) into a CSV table of connectivity matrices with pybrainlife, a format conversion utility.
description: Loads the compressed JSON graph with jgf/igraph and uses pybrainlife to extract its connectivity matrix as conmats.csv tagged with the subject and session. Use it for networks that have no measurements; use the full variant to also export global and local network statistics.

inputs.description: Network datatype (compressed JSON graph) without measurements.

outputs.description: CSV table conmats.csv with the connectivity matrix.
